description: This is a test class for the ApplicantController within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, specifically testing the applicant application process, including form submission, validation, database modifications, and response handling.

classes.name: ApplicantControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class extending KernelTestCase to test various scenarios of the ApplicantController related to recruitment applications, including validation, database state assertions, and response verification.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, truncates specific tables, and populates them with test data before each test case.

methods.name: testHandle
methods.description: Parameterized test method that simulates form submission for a vacancy application, validates responses, and asserts database state and candidate data correctness.

methods.name: dataProviderForController
methods.description: Provides diverse input scenarios (valid, invalid, edge cases) for the 'testHandle' method to test applicant form handling.
